title: End of Surah Al-Hijr: Forgive and Declare

paragraphs.text: The people of the thicket were also wrongdoers, so Allah punished them. Both cities lie on a clear road. The people of Thamud also denied the messengers. Allah gave them His signs, but they turned away. They carved houses out of the mountains and felt safe. But the shriek seized them in the early morning. All that they had earned did not help them at all.
Allah created the heavens, the earth and all between them in truth. The Hour is surely coming. So forgive others in a kind and gentle way. Your Lord is the Creator who knows all.

Allah gave the Prophet the seven often repeated verses and the great Qur'an. Do not look with longing at the pleasures given to some disbelievers. Do not grieve over them. Be gentle and humble with the believers. Say, "I am a clear warner." Some people divided the Qur'an into parts. Allah will question them all about what they did. So declare what you are commanded, and turn away from those who worship others with Allah.
